page: Microsoft Azure FX96-24mds_v2 is a constrained-core virtual machine instance configured on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor, the instance provides 24 dedicated vCPUs alongside an expansive allocation of 1832.0 GB of system memory. This architecture yields an exceptionally dense memory profile of approximately 76.33 GB of RAM per vCPU, catering specifically to memory-bound operations that require fewer compute cores.

Storage subsystems on the FX96-24mds_v2 feature 5670 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity, providing fast, low-latency scratch space directly attached to the host. The instance is also capable of interfacing with Azure Premium Storage for external disk volumes. Acceleration hardware is not included, as the server maintains a GPU count of zero. Public networking does not provision complimentary IPv4 addresses by default, necessitating dedicated network configurations for public egress and ingress.

From an efficiency standpoint, the constrained 24-core configuration allows operators running licensed enterprise software to constrain per-core licensing expenses while maintaining access to host-level memory footprints and large NVMe disk volumes. This makes the FX96-24mds_v2 particularly well suited for in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, electronic design automation (EDA), and heavy transactional relational databases requiring massive memory and fast temporary storage without requiring a full 96-core licensing footprint.

The instance integrates 5670 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage, with no integrated GPU accelerators. This hardware balance provides significant qualitative licensing efficiency for enterprise workloads that require extreme physical memory capacity and high-speed local scratch space without the cost overhead of licensing additional processing cores. Consequently, the configuration serves as an optimal host for in-memory caching systems, large transactional databases, and electronic design automation tools.
